problem: Native OLE/package coverage did not qualify Excel payload identity, metadata mutation, child publication or several DOC storage boundaries. Current tests reproduced a DOC corruption misclassification and an XLS false identity-alias refusal caused by a valid classic note.
changes: Return typed Refused(UnsupportedContent) for storage-ID mutations selecting a valid DOC native ObjectPool storage without editor-managed field ownership. Check the current candidate so removed managed objects are not mistaken for native unmanaged targets. Document the existing native/managed ownership distinction.

Recognize the exact MS-XLS FtCmo(Note)/FtNts/FtEnd grammar as a proven non-storage object identity. Preserve the note as opaque bytes, reserve its ID against collisions, and retain refusals for malformed, extended, duplicate-ID and non-note opaque records.
Add eleven native integration tests across DOC, XLS, XLSX, XLSB and the public facade; add two focused note-identity unit regressions and strengthen an existing DOC transaction test.

Bind three already-passing native DOC storage/body-preservation/child tests to the embedded-payload feature row as well as their prior feature rows. Four additional feature rows now have scoped partial assertions.

verification_scope.excel_identity: XLS, XLSX and XLSB all retain the same 13759-byte Word DOCX child as word-legacy-form-unprotected.docx, SHA-256 a4b37e93f7cf0c93213e419cb42796e361785f4354d50a585dcd5b60ed910778. XLS Obj 3/type 8 resolves MBD00DD3649 (storage position 14497353). XLSX shape 1027 has rId3 package and rId4 preview; XLSB catalog owner /xl/worksheets/sheet1.bin has rId4 package.
verification_scope.xlsx_metadata: Native Document ProgID, EMF preview /xl/media/image2.emf (69384 bytes, SHA-256 828d607c3857f92f8339115446c50beef2346cd3bdf796a22b941ca3c84aed37), from (column 0,row 11,offsets 0/0), to (column 2,row 20,offsets 635000/114300), moveWithCells true and defaultSize false. Alt-text editing inserts exactly one attribute; every other worksheet byte and package member remains unchanged. Shape-ID mutation refuses atomically, save/reopen retains the result and inverse restores every member.
verification_scope.xls_mutation: Clear FtCmo fPrint (24593 to 24577) while preserving object identity, all other subrecords and streams. Exactly one Obj record changes. A colliding ID 1 is rejected atomically because it belongs to the native note. Replacing the selected embedded CFB changes only MBD00DD3649/Package; Workbook, other streams and class identity are preserved through file save/reopen and exact whole-artifact inverse.
verification_scope.xlsb_mutation: Eager, source-backed, lazy-materialized and streamed payload views agree exactly. A public raw-OPC transaction replaces only the embedded Word member with another tracked native DOCX; save/reopen keeps the owner and relationship, preserves all other members and inversely restores all member bytes.
verification_scope.doc_storage: Two native storages (_1853584064 and _1853584157) export every child stream exactly and retain distinct CLSIDs 00020830-0000-0000-C000-000000000046 and 00020821-0000-0000-C000-000000000046. Managed metadata/lifecycle callbacks are not invoked for those unmanaged native targets; failed operations preserve exact source bytes and both storages.
verification_scope.facade_child: Explicitly extracted Word children from all three Excel containers open as DOCX with six paragraphs, exact form markers and query/path agreement. A facade paragraph edit republishes into XLSB, survives file save/reopen, preserves other form markers and parent cached values 49.75 and 14, and the inverse restores the original child.
verification_scope.note_guard: Canonical shared and non-shared FtNts notes contribute a proven object ID without an MBD/LNK alias. Undefined FtNts bytes remain ignored and preserved. Zero/duplicate IDs, invalid shared flags, truncation, extra records and another opaque object type retain conservative mutation refusals.
verification_scope.limits: DOC native field ownership is not implemented by this change. XLSB replacement uses the documented raw-OPC escape hatch, not a typed BrtOleObject editor. Cached previews are retained rather than regenerated; no rendering, activation, macro execution, external resolution, recalculation or fresh Office reopen is claimed. XLSB inverse equality is checked at the package-member level; ZIP compression/transport bytes are not part of its part-level patch contract.
